name: Hiel
bio: Hiel of Bethel rebuilt the city of Jericho during Ahab's reign, in defiance of the curse Joshua had pronounced generations earlier: "Cursed be the man before the LORD, that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it" (Joshua 6:26). The curse fell exactly as spoken — Hiel lost his firstborn son Abiram when he laid Jericho's foundations, and his youngest son Segub when he set up its gates (1 Kings 16:34).
